messages:
elena.docs: Heads-up  found a Ruby quickstart snippet drift that tripped a customer. The README shows `api_token` and an example using HTTParty without timeouts.

rahul.devex: Yikes. Ruby snippets often get overlooked. What did the snippet look like?

elena.docs: From quickstart:```ruby
require 'httparty'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_token: ENV['REDWOOD_API_TOKEN'])
resp = client.generate(prompt: 'hi')
puts resp
```

elena.docs: Problems: our Ruby SDK expects `api_key` (not `api_token`), and the HTTParty example has no timeout/retry guidance. Also sample-apps/ruby/docker-compose.yml uses a secret named `redwood_token` so deploys fail when people port env vars.

samir.sdk: Thanks for catching. The canonical constructor is `Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])` and the SDK wraps Faraday which does timeouts if configured. We should show the helper that sets timeouts. Example to paste:```ruby
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'], request_timeout: 10)
resp = client.generate(prompt: 'hello')
puts resp.body
```

samir.sdk: For people using raw HTTParty we should show a timeout and a note about retries (or prefer the SDK). Example:```ruby
require 'httparty'
resp = HTTParty.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate',
  body: {prompt: 'hello'}.to_json,
  headers: { 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY']}", 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' },
  timeout: 10
)
puts resp.parsed_response
```

rahul.devex: Can you open a PR to update README, fix docker-compose secrets, and add a short "Ruby gotchas" note? Also add a .env.example and a warning not to commit secrets to the sample repo.

elena.docs: Opened PR #5601: updates Ruby quickstart to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, adds HTTParty timeout example, replaces docker-compose secret name to `redwood_api_key`, and adds .env.example + "do not commit" blurb. Preview: https://deploy-preview-docs.redwood.ai/pr-5601

deploy-bot: docs-preview: build 10234 passed  link: https://deploy-preview-docs.redwood.ai/pr-5601

samir.sdk: Tiny follow-up: add a line in the Ruby client README that we accept the legacy REDWOOD_TOKEN env var for one release with a deprecation warning, so existing users don't break immediately. I'll open a small SDK PR after docs merge.

elena.docs: Will add a short "legacy env var" note in the quickstart and link to the changelog. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 

rahul.devex: Nice work. This should cut down on those support tickets.
